# MCP NLTK

## Overview
- **What**: MCP server wrapping NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) for NLP tasks
- **Version**: Latest
- **Category**: nlp | mcp-server
- **Framework**: FastMCP
- **Language**: Python

## Purpose
Provides access to NLTK natural language processing capabilities through MCP tools.

## Available Tools
- Tokenization - Split text into tokens
- POS tagging - Part-of-speech tagging
- Named entity recognition - Extract named entities
- Sentiment analysis - Analyze sentiment
- Text classification - Classify text

## Installation
```bash
cd C:/Users/matts/Projects/TheBigOne/dial-stack/utilities/mcp-servers/mcp-nltk/mcp-nltk-main
pip install -r requirements.txt
python nltk_mcp.py
```

## Use Cases
- Text tokenization and parsing
- Part-of-speech tagging
- Named entity recognition
- Sentiment classification
- Text preprocessing

## Dependencies
- nltk
- fastmcp
